resources.string: Connect to the phone first (Link tab).

1. Turn on Wi-Fi.
2. Settings → Developer options → turn on "Wireless debugging".
3. Tap "Pair device with pairing code". The window shows a 6-digit code and a port. Do not close it: open ADB-phon in split-screen or a floating window.
4. Enter the port and the code below and press "Pair".
5. Press "Connect".

Once, from a computer with USB debugging: adb tcpip 5555 (the program \"Phone in Window with Sound\" has a button for it). Then press the button below and allow debugging on the phone. After a reboot repeat the command.

If this device has root (Magisk), ADB and a computer are not needed: all actions on THIS device run through root. Other devices are still connected by ADB. On first start allow root for this app in Magisk. The switch decides what is used at start; the ADB connect buttons switch to ADB.

The phone becomes a Bluetooth mouse and keyboard for a computer, laptop, tablet, iPhone or TV. Once: tap \"Make visible\", then on the computer add a Bluetooth device and choose this phone. Next times it connects by itself or tap the computer in the list.

The pad is a small copy of the device screen: tap = tap at that spot, hold = long press, drag = swipe. The spot you touched is marked on the pad, and white circles appear on the device screen while this tab is open. To move the highlight on a TV by buttons use \"Keys\", for a pointer use \"Mouse\".

Air mouse: the round switch between the buttons chooses the mode. Teal = switching: tap “Air” to turn it on and tap again to turn it off. Plain = hold: it works only while you hold the button. Move the phone like a pointer; tap “Click” to click.

ADB-phon is a free ADB manager that works on the phone itself: no computer and no root. Highlights: accessibility services and special access (keep enabled after reboot, remove restricted settings), network device search with named favorites, apps and permissions, install APK, files, remote with mouse, air mouse and a real on-screen cursor, screenshots, quick settings, console. In Settings (gear): theme, language (Russian, Ukrainian, English), bug log, and any earlier or newer version of the program from GitHub.
The app is free and has no ads. Voluntary support:
Use the actions carefully: removing system apps can break the phone. The author is not responsible for the consequences.
Turn on the ADB-phon service in Accessibility once, then press the button: the app opens the settings, turns on wireless debugging, reads the pairing code and pairs on its own.

The backup holds everything: settings, device lists, LAN connections and clouds. Passwords and tokens go into the file only if you set a passphrase: the file is then encrypted, and on a new device the passwords are encrypted again with that device key. Without a passphrase the backup has no passwords and tokens.
